nodes.norm_label: 01: review and fix duplicate bank statements in workflows

nodes.label: DuplicateGroup.allocations field
nodes.rationale: Additive data change: statement id to allocation count, filled in duplicateGroups, so tiles can show allocation counts without other logic API changes.

nodes.label: Category
nodes.rationale: Category supplies default treatment and Monthly Budget to reduce repeated input while the three stay separate concepts.

nodes.label: Duplicate Statement
nodes.rationale: Usually caused by the bank changing its description between exports; fixing keeps one statement and Allocations follow the kept one.

nodes.label: Description Difference Highlighting
nodes.rationale: Users previously had to spot the bank's description change by eye; a pure display-only word diff (case-insensitive, whitespace-split) highlights words not present in every group member.

nodes.label: Keep/Delete Statement Tile Toggle
nodes.rationale: Replaces three competing per-row controls (radio + two checkboxes) with a single ToggleGroup; Delete disabled until a keeper exists and only for pairs in group.pairs.

nodes.label: Not a duplicate action
nodes.rationale: Replaces the 'select for separate pair' checkbox; calls dismissDuplicatePair(keeper, tile); in 2-Statement groups placed in footer so the common case is one click.

nodes.label: Fix Duplicates View Selector (Suggested / All / Marked separate)
nodes.norm_label: fix duplicates view selector (suggested / all / marked separate)
nodes.rationale: The manual checkbox and dismissed toggle were two toggles for one choice (which list you view); one Select in FilterBar replaces both, driven by the view search param.

nodes.label: Installed Next.js documentation
nodes.rationale: Read the relevant guide before writing code because APIs and conventions may differ from training data.

nodes.label: Application shell
nodes.rationale: Layout renders while IndexedDB opens and seeds in the background; live queries populate content without a boot gate.

nodes.label: Interactive client routes
nodes.rationale: Search parameters use next/navigation under root Suspense so routes remain static.

nodes.label: Domain operations
nodes.rationale: Domain operations mirror the old Laravel API controller surface so domain knowledge transfers.

nodes.label: Layer segregation
nodes.rationale: UI must respect the separation between rendering, domain operations and persistence.

nodes.label: Live queries
nodes.rationale: Undefined live query results render nothing until the reveal animation can play; blocking loaders are forbidden.

nodes.label: Shared month route shell
nodes.rationale: Overview and Monthly Records share a shell so tab switches never remount the header.

nodes.label: Google OAuth broker
nodes.rationale: Auth route handlers only exchange tokens and log out; financial data never enters them.

nodes.label: UI layer
nodes.rationale: UI renders, reads live queries and calls domain logic; it must not directly import Dexie.

nodes.label: Silent completion (fold-away animation)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors Replace Pending: the fixed or dismissed group folds out via AnimatePresence popLayout; no Alert, toast or result panel.

nodes.label: Graph health warnings
nodes.rationale: Review graph health warnings and explicitly report unresolved refresh failures.

nodes.label: graphify skill
nodes.rationale: Use --update for changed documents/images or pending semantic extraction, and initial setup when graph or tool is missing. No API key is required.

nodes.label: Local graph artifacts
nodes.rationale: Keep graph caches, machine-specific paths and HTML visualizations local, outside public and application routes.

nodes.label: Graph-assisted source navigation
nodes.rationale: Locate symbols and dependencies with the graph before architecture or change-impact investigations, then verify against current source.

nodes.label: Graph refresh after code tasks
nodes.rationale: After tasks changing code, tests, configuration, renames or deletions, refresh after final edits and verification, before commits, PR updates or completion. One refresh covers a batch of edits.

nodes.label: Commit format
nodes.rationale: Gitmoji then robot emoji, lowercase message with proper-noun exceptions.

nodes.label: Stage own changes
nodes.rationale: Stage only this thread’s lines, using patches for mixed files.

nodes.label: Signed commits
nodes.rationale: GPG signatures required; leave changes uncommitted if signing unavailable.

nodes.label: Allocator
nodes.rationale: Split Statements among Records; replace Pending Statements preserving Allocations.

nodes.label: Budgets
nodes.rationale: Custom date periods, amounts, automatic or manual Record membership and progress.

nodes.label: Categories
nodes.rationale: Nested subcategories, default treatment and default Monthly Budgets.

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Monthly income, spending, surplus/shortfall, daily pace, previous-month comparisons, Categories and Monthly Budgets.

nodes.label: Statement-allocation-record model
nodes.rationale: Many-to-many Allocations connect imported Statements and user-managed Records.

nodes.label: Monthly Budgets
nodes.rationale: Core, outlier and custom groups; daily, recurring or unpaced spending; default amounts and monthly overrides.

nodes.label: Records
nodes.rationale: Create, update, delete, assign Categories, Monthly Budgets and treatment; attach Statements via Allocations.

nodes.label: Statement importer
nodes.rationale: DBS, OCBC, UOB, Revolut; CSV/XLS/XLSX; creates Accounts, skips duplicates, preserves same-day order.

nodes.label: Google Drive sync
nodes.rationale: Optional automatic sync with own Google Drive.

nodes.label: Local-first finance tracking
nodes.rationale: Browser IndexedDB storage; optional file backup and personal Google Drive sync.

nodes.label: Sync conflict handling
nodes.rationale: Handles simultaneous changes to browser and Drive copies.

nodes.label: Next.js development server
nodes.rationale: npm run dev runs on port 5173, preserving the Google OAuth origin; stop it after requested route smoke verification.

nodes.label: Generated Next.js agent rules
nodes.rationale: next dev re-adds this block; committing it with the work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Finpoint app icon
nodes.rationale: Compact geometric F plus a round point, restrained charcoal and off-white colors and generous negative space support small-favicon legibility.

nodes.label: Importer Test Isolation
nodes.description: 33 tests and 93 assertions pass after integration. Importer tests use real IndexedDB instead of global module mocks.

nodes.label: Drive Baseline Migration
nodes.description: An added empty dismissal table updates clean Drive baselines; unsynced baselines remain unchanged. Both cases tested.

nodes.label: Dismissal Migration and Backup
nodes.description: Append Dexie migration; include dismissals in backup, reset, sync; accept old backups with empty dismissal table.

nodes.label: Changed Bank Descriptions
nodes.description: Banks rename imported descriptions, causing repeated statements for one activity.

nodes.label: Desktop and Mobile Smoke Checks
nodes.description: Browser checks cover both existing tabs, grouped/manual/pending constraints, dismiss/restore reload, allocation source rules, Pending Records and mobile layout; dev server stopped.

nodes.label: Duplicate Dismissal Migration
nodes.description: Database version 5 follows unchanged main monthly-budget migrations; backup version 4 accepts prior versions with empty dismissals.

nodes.label: Grouped Statement Review
nodes.description: Group eligible pair edges without treating transitive connectivity as proof; users explicitly select survivor and deletion targets.

nodes.label: Duplicate Eligibility
nodes.description: Imported non-pending statements only, same account, calendar day and signed amount in cents in all modes.

nodes.label: Deleted Descriptions Forgotten
nodes.description: No aliases or deleted-description history. Old exports may recreate duplicates; affected records are linked for reconciliation.

nodes.label: Conservative Duplicate Suggestions
nodes.description: Normalize spacing and allow method wording reordering while preserving meaningful words, numeric reference order, and conflicting identifying details. Never delete automatically.

nodes.label: Pair-specific Dismissals
nodes.description: One table stores ordered pair IDs only. Dismissals survive reload/backup/sync, are reversible, and disappear when either statement is deleted.

nodes.label: Completed Fix Duplicates Ticket
nodes.description: One vertical feature ticket resolved after implementation, review, browser verification, tests and graph refresh.

nodes.label: Duplicate Allocation Resolution
nodes.description: Preserve allocated survivor; otherwise move one selected allocation set, requiring a source choice if several exist. Remove other deleted allocations, preserve records and derive pending deficits.

nodes.label: Workflow Behavior Verification
nodes.description: Real IndexedDB domain tests cover matcher boundaries, allocations, migration and backups; lint/types/build and browser smoke checks verify UI behavior.

nodes.label: Workflows Navigation
nodes.description: Rename visible Allocator to Workflows, retain existing routes and add Fix Duplicates alongside allocation and pending replacement.

nodes.label: Atomic Statement Cleanup
nodes.description: Revalidate current statements and allocation capacities and atomically delete statements, obsolete allocations and dismissal references. Survivor imported fields remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Resolved Matcher Review Findings
nodes.description: Standards found no issues; two spec findings resolved with regressions for numeric reference order and meaningful recipient words.

nodes.label: Manual Statement Selection
nodes.description: Toggle reveals manual selection that bypasses descriptions and dismissals but never eligibility constraints.

nodes.label: Single-context Domain Docs
nodes.description: CONTEXT.md is canonical; relevant docs/adr and supplementary GLOSSARY.md are read when present.

nodes.label: Spec and Ticket Files
nodes.description: One spec.md and one numbered issues/<NN>-<slug>.md per ticket, with acceptance criteria and Blocked by.

nodes.label: Local Tracker Operations
nodes.description: Publish by writing local Markdown; fetch by reading; resolve by recording outcome and status.

nodes.label: Ticket Lifecycle
nodes.description: Ready-for-agent, claimed, then resolved; start after blockers resolve and record completion evidence.

nodes.label: Domain and Importer Tests
nodes.description: Run bun test against Dexie with in-memory IndexedDB for domain and importer behavior.

nodes.label: Local Markdown Issue Tracker
nodes.description: Specs and tickets live under .scratch/<feature-slug>/; no publishing to GitHub Issues.

nodes.label: Local Agent Skills
nodes.description: Specs and tickets use the local Markdown tracker; domain exploration follows domain consumer rules.

nodes.label: Domain Documentation Conflicts
nodes.description: Surface vocabulary and ADR conflicts; missing optional documentation does not block work.

nodes.label: Monthly Budget amount
nodes.rationale: Precedence: month's own Override one month, then latest Override default at or before it, otherwise no amount; Default rule unavailable when no earlier Override default exists.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Default
nodes.rationale: Month has no amount of its own and looks back to the latest Override default in an earlier month; unavailable when no earlier Override default exists, so there is always something to inherit.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Override default
nodes.rationale: Default amount applying from its month onward; look-back stops at the latest one reached. Changing a month away from it makes later months look further back.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Override one month
nodes.rationale: Amount for that month only; months looking back skip it so one-off changes do not leak forward.
